description: Two independent voltage-controlled attenuators — an attenuator can only reduce a signal

params.text: Sets that channel's level, in decibels unless LIN is on
Linear in amplitude, which suits processing CV; otherwise linear in decibels

inputs.text: Each level takes a 0-10V CV, attenuated by its knob
The signal that channel attenuates; the channels patched here set that half's polyphony

outputs.text: That channel's signal after its level
